about_the_game:
Have you ever dreamed of crafting beautiful floral arrangements that brighten someone's day?

Flowers and Favours is a cozy and relaxing florist sim where you can craft beautiful bouquets, experiment with different blooms, and run your very own flower shop. This is your space to create and unwind.

Features:

Listen and Learn - Chat with adorable customers to understand their unique stories and needs for the perfect bouquet

Unleash Your Creativity - Create one-of-a-kind bouquets using intuitive and flexible design tools 

Complete Your Masterpiece With the Perfect Wrap - Select from elegant wrapping options, ribbons, and finishing touches to make each bouquet truly special

Upcoming Features:

  • Photo Mode - Capture your beautiful bouquets and keep them in a special memory book.

  • Shop Customization - Decorate your flower shop and design a space that feels uniquely yours.

  • Creative Workbench - Personalize your crafting area to match your floral style.

  • Special Events - Manage seasonal rushes with a calendar system for holidays and celebrations

Project Roadmap:

  • March: Release of full trailer showcasing gameplay

  • April-May: Playable demo available for everyone

  • August-September: Full game release 🎉

Hello! I'm Iris - solo dev of this cozy game 👩‍💻
I’m working hard to bring Flowers and Favors to life 🌸 Support me by adding the game to your wishlist and following along on Steam!

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: No need for a dedicated graphic card
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: -

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: No need for a dedicated graphic card
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: -

name: Flowers And Favours: Florist Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11
  • Processor: x86, x64 architecture
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be enough
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
  • Sound Card: -

short_description: Flowers And Favours is a relaxing cozy florist sim. Run your own flower shop, experiment with a stunning variety of florals, and craft unique bouquets for your adorable customers. Your floral journey begins today!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Spanish - Latin America
